note: MEASURED test counts per build-tooling directory, used as FLOORS by tools/run-suite-tests.mjs. A directory recorded here that stops being discovered, or that runs fewer tests than this, fails the gate loudly — a number that drops is a failure even when every test passes, and a glob that matches nothing exits zero. Rewrite only with `node tools/run-suite-tests.mjs tools --update-floors`, on a green tree, as a deliberate single act: this file must never be edited by parallel workers, because a concurrent read-modify-write on a shared list is the exact defect the discovering gate was built to end.
